## Community Skill candidate

### User problem

What user-provided material does this Skill handle, and what result does it
return?

### Related Issue (optional)

Starter Issue or proposal Issue, if one exists:

### Boundary

- Intended trigger:
- Must not trigger:
- Failure/insufficient-input behavior:

### Verification

- [ ] `npm run community:skills:check` passes
- [ ] At least one positive and one negative eval case are included
- [ ] I searched existing Skills and open pull requests for obvious duplicates
- [ ] I tested the Skill against the acceptance examples described here or in
      the related Issue

### Authorship and safety

- [ ] `provenance.json` lists me and every third-party source
- [ ] The contribution contains no private, customer, course-restricted, or
      confidential material
- [ ] The contribution contains no scripts, executables, binaries, network
      access, external writes, or new dependencies
- [ ] I understand that merge means “community candidate”; it does not mean Hub
      publication, release bundling, or production approval
- [ ] Every commit is signed off with `git commit -s` (DCO)
